labour.loadingIncluded: Fully-loaded hourly cost INCLUDES: KSH total gross earnings (base + bonuses / premiums + allowances, as KSH measures them) for the occupation, 2025 national average indexed +8.4% to 2026 and scaled ×0.9406 to the four clusters; paid annual leave (27 days) and weekday public holidays inside the 12 monthly salaries; employer-paid sick leave at 70% for 10 days; the 30% shift allowance (Mt. 141) on the 50% of hours that fall 18:00–06:00 in rotating 3 × 8 h (shop-floor roles), carried into leave and sick pay; szocho 13% on all of it; divided by 1728 productive hours.
labour.loadingNotIncluded: NOT included (not shown to be standard by a source, or not verified): 13th-month salary (not statutory in Hungary; any annual bonus is already inside KSH total earnings); cafeteria / SZÉP-card benefits (common but not statutory; their tax would add on top); commuting reimbursement (statutory share of pass / ticket cost, Korm. rendelet 39/2010 — not verified); rehabilitation contribution for employers ≥ 25 staff short of the 5% disabled-employee quota (not verified); work clothing, occupational medicine, training time; overtime, weekend and holiday premiums; child additional leave; agency margins; the vocational-training contribution (believed abolished 2022).
labour.short: 4-cluster, KSH total earnings by FEOR occupation + szocho, 1,728 productive h
